text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to enable `tempest-14b-opt` in the model catalog during the Wed change window (2025-07-09 02:00 UTC). Goal: replace the web-tier low-latency path with this quantv3 variant. Need fallback ordering, pinlist, and rollback thresholds. deploy-bot will run a staged canary (5/25/100).

kevin: Sounds good. Quick question — what's the current perf baseline / p95 we expect?

maria: P95 baseline ~180ms (8k context, quantv3 on A100). Acceptance criteria: latency P95 increase <=15% vs baseline, error rate <0.5%, and no quality regression on the smoke eval. If any threshold trips, we'll rollback.

sophia: Please add telemetry hooks: token-rate, 4xx/5xx slices, nvtx traces for the hot paths, and a sample of generated outputs to the eval harness. Also call out EU pinning separately — we want region-specific fallbacks. :eyes:

ali: Pinlist proposal: [prod-api-v1, chat-service, emb-async]. Prod-api needs a dedicated slot on the slot allocator for the first 24h. Also: KV-cache prefix warmup required.

deploy-bot: schedule created — `tempest-14b-opt` enable: canary 5% at 1758020000, 25% at 1758023600, 100% at 1758037200. Fallback chain set to: `tempest-14b-std` -> `aurora-13b` -> `titan-3b`. Auto-rollback thresholds: latency +15% OR error rate +0.8% OR quality regression >2% on canary eval. Notifications: #eng-releases and #oncall.

maria: Prefer swapping fallback order to keep `aurora-13b` before `titan-3b` because semantic parity is better; confirm.

kevin: Confirmed — aurora before titan. Also quant variant preference: prefer `quantv3` -> `quantv2` fallback, not raw fp32.

sophia: For EU region we should prefer `aurora-13b` as the immediate fallback because Titan capacity in eu-west is tight. Make that region override.

ali: Ops notes — allocate 2x warm pods for prod-api and run KV cache warmup. Commands I'm using: 
```
# warm pods
slotctl allocate --service prod-api-v1 --count 2 --reason "tempest enable warmup"
# warm kv cache
kv-warm --prefix /cache/tempest --model tempest-14b-opt --samples 5000
```
I'll run these 30m before the canary start.

deploy-bot: ack — warmup scheduled 30m before canary. Canary traffic shaping and slot pins applied to prod-api-v1, chat-service, emb-async at canary start.

maria: Rollback procedure: revert pin assignments, drain canary traffic, and set canary cooldown 30m. Who's oncall for rollback window 02:00–06:00 UTC?

kevin: I'm oncall 02:00–06:00 UTC — I'll lead the rollback if thresholds trip. I'll also be available for a quick revert of the catalog pin set.

sophia: I'll watch the eval diffs and open an incident if quality regression >1% relative to baseline. I can push a quick revert PR for the catalog ordering if needed.

maria: Great — :thumbsup: I'll post release notes to #release-notes with the eval snapshot and the exact pinlist. One more ask: can we set a soft hold at 25% for 15m to validate telemetry before proceeding to 100%?

deploy-bot: updated schedule — 25% hold 15m for manual ack (can be auto-continued if no thresholds breach). Ack reactions from: kevin, sophia, ali recorded.

maria: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the release note draft in ~10m and tag the oncall.
